title: Customer Success Manager - Flemish speaker
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Motork
description_html:
MotorK. Driving the AI revolution in automotive.

MotorK is Europe's leading sales and marketing technology company for the automotive sector. We build AI-powered tools: from CRM and inventory management to predictive analytics and digital advertising, that help manufacturers and dealerships sell smarter and deliver better customer experiences. 90% of European automotive manufacturers run on our SparK Platform, alongside 6,000+ dealerships across the continent.

We move fast, we think big, and AI is at the core of everything we do, not as a buzzword, but as the engine behind every product decision we make. We're building a team of people who are genuinely curious about AI, who experiment with it, push it, and find new ways to use it to solve real problems.

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Success team to be based in our Antwerp office. This role would require a relocation to Belgium. 

The Role

The Customer Success Manager role will cover a wide range of account management, onboarding, and client growth tasks, as it liaises with the Delivery, Sales, and Product teams. The Customer Success Manager will:

  • Serve as the primary reference point for clients throughout their entire lifecycle with MotorK, taking full account management ownership.
  • Own the customer onboarding journey from contract signature to successful product go-live, ensuring product activation aligns with the dealer’s digital strategy and signed SLA.
  • Conduct structured onboarding sessions, translate client requirements into clear delivery briefs, and manage cross-functional execution.
  • Drive adoption, prevent churn, and execute upselling/cross-selling activities to meet individual and team revenue goals.
  • Provide ongoing digital marketing, lead generation, and lead management expertise using the DealerK Method.
  • Track and report on key account metrics, including NPS, retention, time-to-go-live, and product adoption rates.

Requirements

Our ideal Customer Success Manager will have previous experience in Sales, Account Management, or Customer Success (ideally within a SaaS or digital product environment) and digital marketing strategy knowledge.

As well as:

  • Previous experience in account management or customer success, with a strong plus for end-to-end customer onboarding ownership.
  • Deep understanding of the B2B automotive dealer sector and web technologies (CMS, SEO concepts) or SaaS industry.
  • Project management mindset with proven ability to bridge business requirements and technical delivery teams.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Native Flemish speaker, fluency in French and English.
  • A proactive, goal-oriented approach with a passion for digital technologies and automotive innovation.

Work Pattern and Location

  • Permanent contract, full time
  • Monday – Friday
  • Hybrid role with occasional field trips 
  • Location: Antwerp

Benefits

  • Salary range: 40k-50k depending on experience
  • Commission plan: between 10 and 20% of fixed salary
  • Relocation support package
  • Meal Vouchers (for each day worked) 8€
  • ECO Vouchers 
  • Hospitalisation Insurance 
  • Mobile phone and SIM 
  • Three days of onboarding in our Milan office, with evening team building event
  • Bi-monthly appointment for collaboration days, with free breakfast in the office
  • Modern centrally located office, with gym onsite 
  • Internal training paths and support with external education
  • Diverse and dynamic environment, with plenty of opportunity to grow and make an impact 
  • Company benefits including discounts on famous brands

What You Can Expect From the Recruitment Process:

  • HR interview - AI fluency assessment (English)
  • Hiring Manager interview (French, Dutch)
  • Peer interview / skills assessment (French, Dutch)
  • C-level interview (English)

title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Schiller International University
description_html:
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
  • Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
  • Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.


Your Profile

  • An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
  • Passion and commitment to student support and success.
  • Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction.
  • Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus.
  • Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency
  • Local language (French, German, Spanish), desirable
Competencies
  • Communication Connection and Service 
  • Global Mindset 
  • Achieving Results 
  • Driving Innovation and Managing Change 
  • Learning and Development 
  • Drives Vision and Leads Courageously
  • Strong focus on quality and continuous improvement 
  • Leadership skills 
  • Strong intercultural communication skills and cultural agility

title: Senior Creative Strategist (all genders)

description_html:
They do 08/15. We create 9:16

Wir schaffen Relevanz, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erreichen und zu skalieren.

Sichtbarkeit ist nicht automatisch Relevanz. Reichweite nicht automatisch Wirkung.

WeCreate ist eine Social-First Brand Building Agency für das Interest-Media-Zeitalter. Wir übersetzen Social Signals und Community Insights in Social Strategien, Content-Systeme und messbare Markenwirkung – als strategischer Partner, Campaign Co-Pilot oder operatives Umsetzungsteam. 

Für Marken, die nicht nur stattfinden, sondern kulturell und in ihren Communities relevant sein wollen, suchen wir dich als Senior Creative Strategist (all genders).

Du verbindest strategische Klarheit mit kreativer Führung. Als strategische Stimme von WeCreate entwickelst du die Marken- und Plattformlogik unserer Kund:innen, übersetzt sie in wirksame Content-Systeme und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten Idee ein konsistenter, relevanter und plattformnativer Content-Output wird.


Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest die strategische und kreative Gesamtausrichtung komplexer Kunden-Mandate von der Social Marken-Positionierung über Plattform- und Kanalstrategien bis zur übergreifenden Content-Systematik und Qualitätssicherung über alle Projektphasen hinweg.

Dabei arbeitest du eigenständig auf Senior-Level, triffst Entscheidungen mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum und kommunizierst sicher mit den Marken-Entscheider:innen. Du führst Creative Reviews, moderierst Sparrings-Formate und gibst Kund:innen sowie internen Teams Orientierung, wenn strategische, kreative oder operative Fragen zusammenkommen.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der integrierten Arbeit mit dem Team: Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat arbeitest du im WeCreate-Office in Hamburg. Zusätzlich bringst du die notwendige Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate mit auch dann, wenn diese außerhalb deines üblichen Arbeitsortes stattfinden.


Dein Impact bei WeCreate

Du gibst Marken und Teams Richtung. Du sorgst dafür, dass strategische Klarheit nicht in Präsentationen endet, sondern in kreativen Systemen, relevanten Inhalten und konsistenter Markenwirkung sichtbar wird.

Du verbindest die Perspektiven von Kund:innen, Creative Studio, Beratung, Produktion und Plattformen. Dabei bist du mehr als Ideengeber:in. Du entwickelst die Logik hinter der Arbeit, führst durch komplexe Entscheidungen und stellst sicher, dass Qualität über alle Projektphasen hinweg erkennbar bleibt.

Als Senior Creative Strategist stärkst du nicht nur einzelne Kundenprojekte, sondern auch die strategische und kreative Kompetenz von WeCreate als Organisation.


Das erwartet dich:

  • Strategische und kreative Gesamtverantwortung: Du führst komplexe Kunden-Mandate ganzheitlich von digitaler Markenpositionierung, Plattform- und Kanalstrategie bis zur kreativen Leitidee und belastbaren Umsetzungslogik.
  • Seniorige Kunden- und Teamführung: Du präsentierst Strategien und Kreativkonzepte überzeugend, moderierst Sparrings-Formate und führst interdisziplinäre Teams zu klaren, tragfähigen Entscheidungen.
  • Creative Strategy und Narrative Systems: Du entwickelst kulturell relevante Leitideen, Narrative und Content-Systeme, die über Plattformen, Formate und Touchpoints hinweg funktionieren.
  • Qualitäts- und Entscheidungsführung: Du sicherst die strategische und kreative Qualität von der Aufgabenstellung bis zum finalen Output, gibst präzises Feedback und erkennst früh, wenn Idee, Marke und Plattformlogik auseinanderlaufen.
  • Playbooks, Standards und fachliches Sparring: Du entwickelst verbindliche Leitplanken für das Creative Studio und bist ein:e erfahrene:r Sparringspartner:in für Kund:innen sowie Creative-, Strategy- und Beratungsteams.
  • Coaching und Wissensaufbau: Du teilst dein Wissen aktiv, coachst Kolleg:innen und stärkst nicht nur einzelne Arbeiten, sondern auch die strategische und kreative Arbeitsweise des Teams.
  • Systemische Zusammenarbeit und Weiterentwicklung: Du arbeitest eng mit Social-, Creator-, Community-, Production- und Paid-Teams zusammen, begleitest relevante Produktionen und Offsites und entwickelst interne Prozesse sowie KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen weiter. Dafür bringst du Reise- und Terminflexibilität mit.


Das bringst du mit:

Das sind deine Kernkompetenzen

  • Du kannst komplexe Marken- und Business-Herausforderungen in klare strategische Positionierungen, kreative Leitideen und umsetzbare Content-Systeme übersetzen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der strategischen und kreativen Gesamtverantwortung für anspruchsvolle Kunden-Mandate, Kampagnen oder Markenaufgaben.

  • Du kannst Plattform- und Kanalstrategien entwickeln und mit einer übergreifenden Content-Systematik verbinden.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Xyz Reality
description_html:
Build the infrastructure powering the future of construction

At XYZ Reality, we’ve created the world’s first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our technology, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to help construction teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, the infrastructure behind our technology needs to scale with us.

We’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to take ownership of the cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices powering our BIM Platform, working across Azure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, security and developer tooling.

The Role

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with broad ownership across our cloud and platform infrastructure.

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Data and Security teams to build reliable, scalable infrastructure while improving how our developers deploy, monitor and troubleshoot their services.

We want DevOps to be an enabler rather than a gatekeeper. That means building the tooling, automation and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to move quickly and safely without creating unnecessary dependencies on DevOps.

You’ll have the autonomy to identify where our infrastructure and engineering practices can improve and take ownership of making those improvements happen.

The role is based in our London office on a hybrid basis, with 3 days per week in the office.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Architect, maintain and evolve our Microsoft Azure infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters

  • Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform, ARM templates and Helm

  • Design and improve CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, enabling fast, safe and repeatable deployments

  • Build observability across our infrastructure and services through monitoring, logging, alerting and distributed tracing

  • Improve platform reliability, scalability and performance through capacity planning, autoscaling and resource optimisation

  • Build and maintain disaster recovery, backup and failover strategies

  • Strengthen infrastructure security across areas including network policies, secrets management and platform hardening

  • Establish and improve incident response processes, on-call practices, runbooks and blameless post-mortems

  • Work with our Data team to support reliable and scalable PostgreSQL and MongoDB environments

  • Build self-service tooling, templates and documentation that reduce unnecessary reliance on DevOps

  • Support infrastructure for data pipelines and AI/ML model deployment as our technology continues to evolve

  • Partner directly with developers on deployment, troubleshooting and infrastructure best practices.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a strong, hands-on DevOps Engineer who is comfortable owning complex infrastructure and operating across a broad technical environment.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Demonstrable in-depth experience in DevOps, Infrastructure or Cloud Engineering

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure

  • Deep experience with Kubernetes, including cluster design, networking, storage, upgrades and troubleshooting

  • Strong Infrastructure-as-Code experience using Terraform, ARM templates or equivalent

  • Experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions

  • Strong experience with containers and Docker

  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting and observability within production environments

  • Good knowledge of infrastructure security, including network segmentation, encryption, secrets management and audit logging

  • Experience building automation and tooling using Python, Go, Bash or TypeScript

  • Strong troubleshooting skills and experience taking ownership of production infrastructure and incidents

  • The ability to make pragmatic technical decisions and clearly explain infrastructure trade-offs.

Strong AWS or GCP experience could also be relevant where you can demonstrate the ability to transfer that knowledge into an Azure environment.

Experience with high-availability infrastructure, PostgreSQL or MongoDB, AI/ML infrastructure, ETL/data pipelines, FinOps or SOC 2/ISO 27001 environments would be a bonus.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who enjoys automating away problems rather than repeatedly solving them manually. You’ll be comfortable taking ownership, challenging processes that don’t scale and building the tools and practices that make the wider engineering team more effective.

Why Join Us

  • 🚀 Join a Series B business at an exciting stage of international growth

  • 🏠 Hybrid working from our London office

  • 🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

  • 🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

  • 🎄 Additional Christmas shutdown days

  • 🪙 Biannual salary reviews

  • 🥳 Summer & Christmas company events

  • 🍣 Free Thursday lunch and after-work gatherings

  • 💰 Employee referral scheme

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

  • 🌍 Make a real-world impact revolutionising the construction industry

If you’re a Senior DevOps Engineer who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex infrastructure challenges and building environments that enable engineering teams to move faster, we’d love to hear from you.

If you'd like to see the products and technology we have created so far on our journey you can view it in action through our YouTube and Website

title: Strategic Client Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Flock
description_html:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Our largest fleet clients are hugely important to Flock: they have more vehicles, more data and more opportunity to benefit from everything our connected proposition can offer, and we want to give them an even better experience as we grow. We’re looking for a Strategic Client Manager to become the primary face of Flock for our largest customers, owning the relationship and making sure they get the very best from us.

Nearly all of our business comes through brokers, and that remains central to how we work: you’ll sit at the heart of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business to deliver a brilliant joined-up service. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution, and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts, manage client queries and improve reporting, freeing up more time for relationships and problem-solving.

You’ll have the opportunity to build our corporate client management approach from the ground up: shaping account reviews and performance reporting, bringing together claims, safety, underwriting and finance for our biggest clients, and taking real ownership when something needs to get done. Success is simple: our clients stay with us, get more value from Flock and recommend us to others.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the relationship with a portfolio of Flock’s largest fleet clients, becoming their primary point of contact and developing a strong understanding of their business.

  • Build and run our corporate account management approach: client reviews, reporting, relationship cadence and account planning.

  • Work closely with brokers and our Broker Development Managers to deliver a coordinated experience for every client.

  • Bring together teams across Flock, including claims, safety, underwriting and finance, to resolve client questions and issues quickly, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organisations.

  • Identify retention risks early and create clear plans to protect our most important accounts.

  • Support the commercial management of the smaller number of corporate clients that work with Flock directly.

  • Help shape and improve Flock’s wider client service proposition, including account reviews, portal engagement, safety support, claims and reporting, feeding client feedback back into the business.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from account research and meeting preparation to query management, meeting summaries and client reporting.

 

What you’ll need

  • Strong experience within the insurance industry, with a clear understanding of the broker–client–insurer dynamic and the judgement to know where you add value, without duplicating the broker’s role, creating confusion or adding unnecessary layers for the client.

  • Experience in a client-facing role such as insurer account or deal management, broker account management, claims relationship management or a similar position.

  • A proven track record of managing important client relationships and delivering strong retention or customer satisfaction, with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders across clients, brokers and internal teams.

  • Strong commercial judgement. You can identify when an account is at risk, understand what matters to the client and build a plan to retain them.

  • The ability to work effectively within a broker-led relationship, knowing when to lead, when to support the broker and when to bring in specialist colleagues.

  • Energy and ownership: comfortable picking up a problem and driving it through to a solution, and confident using AI in your daily work to work faster and deliver a better client experience.

  • Preferable: experience with large, complex or multi-site corporate clients, Commercial Motor Fleet or fleet risk and safety experience, or exposure to the claims process or to building an account management or client service proposition.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

Unternehmensbeschreibung

Mit über 800+ Partnern zählt Immo-Marketer zu den etabliertesten Marketing- und Vertriebsagenturen der Immobilienbranche. Unser Expertenteam hilft Immobilienmaklern, Bauträgern & Immobilienvertrieben bei der Gewinnung neuer Kunden, indem wir professionelle Social-Media-Kampagnen erstellen und beim Aufbau digitaler Vertriebsprozesse begleiten.

Mit einem 25-Köpfigen Team unterstützen wir Partner in der gesamten DACH-Region und sind durchgehend auf der Suche nach neuen Kolleginnen & Kollegen, die in einem stabilen Umfeld ihre Stärken einbringen wollen. Wenn Du bereit bist, mit Struktur und klaren Prozessen zum weiteren Wachstum des Unternehmens beizutragen, dann werde jetzt Teil unseres Teams und starte Deine Karriere bei Immo-Marketer.

Als Wirtschaftsinformatiker/-in - Vollzeit (m/w/d) systematisierst du Prozessabläufe, setzt eigenverantwortlich Projekte um und implementierst neue Prozesse in unserem Unternehmen. Deine Aufgaben:

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme. Die Übernahmequote liegt aktuell bei über 95%.

title: Robotics Software Engineer Intern – Swarm Systems (m/f/d)

description_html:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile team building autonomous robotic systems
  • Contribute to software that is tested on real robotic platforms and in the field
  • Gain hands-on experience with state-of-the-art technologies in robotics, autonomy, and multi-agent systems
  • Work closely with experienced robotics and embedded engineers
  • Take ownership of meaningful technical projects while receiving guidance from the team
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and a collaborative engineering culture


Your mission

Join our robotics team working on autonomous systems that operate as coordinated, distributed agents in real-world environments. 

As a Software Engineering Intern, you will contribute to the development and validation of our multi-UAV system, with a particular focus on software tooling, simulation, and system observability. 

Depending on your background and the project, you may also contribute to areas such as SLAM, navigation, perception, planning, or multi-agent coordination. This is a hands-on internship where you will develop and test software, work with real robotic systems, and see how your work performs beyond simulation. 

  • Develop data-driven dashboards and tools to monitor, analyze, and visualize system performance
  • Extend our simulation framework with KPIs, automated scenarios, and evaluation workflows
  • Analyze simulation and field-test data to identify issues and opportunities for improvement
  • Contribute to the core robotics stack in areas such as estimation, perception, planning, control, or mission execution
  • Collaborate closely with robotics, simulation, embedded, and domain experts
  • Gain practical experience developing and validating software for complex autonomous systems


Your profile

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Autonomous Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
  • Good programming skills in C++, ideally modern C++ (17/20)
  • Solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and software engineering
  • Basic understanding of robotics concepts such as coordinate frames, sensor data, estimation, planning, or control
  • Comfortable working in Linux
  • Curious about complex roboticsystems and motivated to understand how things work beyond your individual component
  • Able to work independently on a defined technical problem while actively seeking feedback when needed
  • Genuine interest in autonomous systems, robotics, and defense technology


Nice to have

You do not need to bring all of these — experience from university projects, research, student teams, personal projects, or previous internships counts. 

  • Experience with ROS or ROS 2
  • Experience with real robots, embedded systems, or hardware-in-the-loop setups
  • Exposure to SLAM, navigation, computer vision, estimation, filtering, planning, or control
  • Interest or experience in multi-agent systems, swarming, or distributed robotics
  • Experience working with LiDAR or camera data
  • Exposure to PX4 or ArduPilot
  • Experience with simulation frameworks such as Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or Unreal Engine
  • Experience with embedded platforms, GPUs, or networking
  • Exposure to machine learning methods


What else

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn
  • Structured and reliable way of working
  • Comfortable working in an environment where not every problem has a predefined solution
  • Collaborative and open to technical feedback
  • High ethical standards and disciplined workethic
  • Extra-curricular engineering projects, robotics competitions, research, or other technical achievements are a plus

The practical part 

  • Duration: 3–6 months, full-time
  • Eligibility: NATO-aligned nationality or close ally citizenship is required

title: Principal Engineer - Autonomous Systems (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at autonomous-teaming
description_html:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile and ambitious team creating the future of autonomous systems
  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy 
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture


Your mission

Join Autonomous Teaming Solutions and build next-generation autonomous robotic systems for demanding real-world environments. You will take end-to-end technical ownership and responsibility of a mission-critical robotics product where perception, system performance, and reliability directly impact operational success. 

As Principal Engineer, you carry overall technical responsibility. You have the final word on architecture, integration and deployment - and you carry the consequences when the system fails. No project manager above you. You decide, you deliver. You work directly with company leadership, not as a career step, but because you are the deepest technically. Your place is still in the team: building, not reporting.

  • You own a complex autonomous system end-to-end - from architecture to field deployment.
  • You build yourself solutions - every day, in the code, next to your team. With us, leading means going first.
  • You are the tiebreaker on technical decisions across all subsystems.
  • You cut whatever does not pay into the next milestone - before you optimize.
  • You test in the field, with measurable and clear pass/fail criteria.


Your profile

  • You are a builder. You have already put things into the world. Systems, products, projects with real users. Not just planned, not conceptualized: built.
  • You have built something of your own before: a company, a product, a project with no one standing behind you. You know what real responsibility feels like. 
  • Deep knowledge in real-time embedded systems, sensor fusion or perception. Proven by systems that run and make a difference. 
  • You have taken something from zero to running hard- and software solutions. Solely responsible, with numbers to show for it.
  • C++ and ROS2 under a latency budget is your terrain.
  • Your first reaction to a new requirement is to ask whether it can be dropped.
  • You have made engineers better by building next to them and coach them.
  • You build in your own time too, because you cannot do otherwise.


What else

  • Citizenship of a NATO member country or close ally.


Why us?

How we work

Clear ownership, everything else is bureaucracy. Every system has exactly one owner with the final word. No V-model, no phase gates, no sign-off meetings. Requirements get challenged, not worked through. Delete first, then simplify, then accelerate - in that order.

Our milestones are binary. Testing happens in the field, not in simulation.


What you get
  • Full technical authority over a system in active deployment.
  • Direct contact with the customer, no layers in between.
  • A team that owns the mission itself.
  • Munich, 5 days on-site. We build together.

No job for you if
  • You need three meetings before a decision gets made.
  • You want a title. What we hand out is the final word and full consequence.
  • A good design matters more to you than a running, functional system.

title: ML Data Engineer (m/f/d) - Sensor Data & Pipelines
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at autonomous-teaming
description_html:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile team creating the future of autonomous systems
  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy 
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture


Your mission

This role owns the data foundation of our perception systems end-to-end — the layer that directly determines model performance in real-world environments. You'll set the technical direction for how we collect, curate, and continuously improve the datasets behind object detection, working as a senior technical partner to ML, perception, and robotics teams — turning raw, messy sensor data into reliable, production-grade systems at scale.

You will take full ownership of the ML data lifecycle — from architecture decisions on ingestion and pipelines, through labeling strategy and QA, to driving continuous, metrics-informed dataset improvement — and will be expected to bring judgment and prior experience to how this is done, not just execute a defined process.



What you'll do:

  • Architect and own scalable pipelines for ingesting, organizing, and preprocessing large volumes of time-series camera and multi-sensor data (RGB, IR, thermal, depth, IMU)
  • Drive the strategy behind our object detection datasets, ensuring quality, diversity, and statistical representativeness at scale
  • Design and operate active learning loops that connect model performance directly to data selection and improvement priorities
  • Own labeling workflows end-to-end — tooling decisions, QA methodology, consistency standards, and coordination of annotation efforts
  • Partner closely with AI Engineers to diagnose model weaknesses, bias, and drift, and translate findings into concrete dataset strategy
  • Plan and lead data collection campaigns (field recordings, drone/video capture) to close gaps with high-value real-world data
  • Build internal tools and dashboards that give the org visibility into dataset quality, distribution, and performance gaps


Your profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and data processing frameworks (Pandas, NumPy, vectorized operations, multiprocessing)
  • Proven track record building and owning ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale video and sensor datasets in production
  • Deep experience with data orchestration and lifecycle management for ML/computer vision workflows, including dataset versioning and reproducibility
  • Strong command of object detection pipelines (Detectron2, MMDetection, COCO format, bounding-box standards)
  • Demonstrated experience designing active learning, uncertainty sampling, or semi-supervised dataset workflows
  • Deep familiarity with data annotation platforms (CVAT, Label Studio) and building automated QA/consistency checks
  • Strong grasp of evaluation metrics for object detection (IoU, mAP, precision-recall curves, class-wise metrics)
  • Comfortable owning decisions around databases (SQL/NoSQL), file systems, and large-scale image, video, and sensor dataset management
  • Track record of working cross-functionally and influencing perception, deployment, robotics, and data infrastructure teams
  • Fluent in English; German and/or French are a plus


Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud storage and MLOps tools (AWS S3, MinIO, ClearML, MLFlow, Weights & Biases).
  • Familiarity with ROS / robotics data formats (bag files, TF trees, sensor_msgs), Docker, or embedded ML workflows.
  • Prior work with robotics, drones, or multi-sensor perception systems, including IR, LiDAR, radar, or audio datasets.


What else

  • Outside-the-box creativity with a blend of conceptual and systematic design thinking.
  • High intrinsic motivation, attention to detail, and strong problem-solving mindset.
  • Structured, methodical, and reliable execution, even under uncertainty.
  • Humble, collaborative, and mission-driven — values collective success over ego.
  • High ethical standards and disciplined work ethic.
  • Extra-curricular achievements, leadership, or unique projects are a plus.
  • NATO-aligned nationality or close ally citizenship is required.


Why us?

Join us to shape the future of AI-driven defense!

title: Werkstudent Content Creation TikTok (Mensch*)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Goodlife
description_html:
Warum Mensch*? Weil wir Diversität schätzen!

Wir sehen Menschen mit ihren Stärken und bieten dazu passende Arbeitsplätze. Deine Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Sexualität oder Geschlecht sind dabei keine Auswahlkriterien. Sei du selbst und wachse mit uns. Welcome to the Goodlife!


Deine Aufgaben bei uns

Du hast Lust, unseren HEJ TikTok-Kanal weiter aufzubauen und dabei richtig kreativ zu werden? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig: Du entwickelst eigene Ideen, planst Videoskripte und setzt sie direkt um – von der ersten Skizze bis zum finalen Edit liegt der Content in deinen Händen.

  • Du entwickelst kreative Videoformate, die TikTok lieben könnte – snackable, schnell, authentisch.
  • Du drehst eigene kurze Videos zu Produkten, BTS-Moments, Team-Life und Community-Formaten.
  • Du schneidest deinen Content selbst und bringst ihn auf FYP-Level.
  • Du hast TikTok im Blut: Trends erkennst du früh und verwandelst sie in HEJ-relevante Ideen – und bringst sie aktiv ins wöchentliche Redaktionsmeeting ein.
  • Du erfindest mit Leichtigkeit eigene kreative Konzepte, Stories und Hooks, die hängen bleiben.
  • Du planst deine Content- und Videoideen passend zu unseren Launch- und Aktionsplanungen in einem Redaktionsplan.
  • Du testest verschiedene Formate, analysierst, was funktioniert – und optimierst kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du bereitest monatliche Performance- und Content-Reportings auf.
  • Als Teil des Teams arbeitest eng mit dem Content & Communications Kolleginnen zusammen, damit alles zur Marke passt und dein Content auf Kampagnen und Markenbotschaften abgestimmt ist.


Dein Profil

  • Du bist idealerweise kürzlich mit deinem Master-Studiengang mit Bezug zu Medien, Kommunikation, Marketing, Design oder Film gestartet und suchst eine andauernde Werkstudierendentätigkeit neben deinem Studium.
  • Du lebst TikTok nicht nur, sondern verstehst, warum ein Video funktioniert – Hook, Pacing, Sound, Trend-Timing.
  • Erste Praxis als Content Creator:in bringst du über deinen eigenen Kanal oder schon aus einem Unternehmenskontext mit.
  • Du bist sicher im Videoschnitt, etwa mit CapCut, und bringst idealerweise Grundkenntnisse in Videoproduktion mit, von Kamera über Licht bis Ton – oder bist ambitioniert, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.
  • Vor der Kamera bist du in deinem Element, selbstsicher, authentisch, nahbar für deine Community.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und sicher auf Deutsch – deine Community folgt dir gerne, und auch die Abstimmung mit dem Content & Communications Team läuft reibungslos.

title: Embedded Software & Systems Consultant (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Invensity Group
description_html:
Welcome

Are you passionate about embedded software, industrial communication, and intelligent drive systems? Then join INVENSITY. Together with our customers, we develop innovative solutions for the next generation of industrial control and drive technologies and actively drive the digital transformation of industry.

Your contribution: You’ll develop and optimize software for modern controller platforms, variable-frequency drives, and servo drives. With your expertise in real-time communication, embedded systems, and industrial networks, you’ll lay the foundation for high-performance, reliable, and future-proof automation solutions.



What can you expect?

  • Help shape the next generation of intelligent IoT solutions by developing innovative software for open communication protocols and TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking) technologies on new and existing embedded platforms
  • Bring together various technologies by integrating, validating, and continuously optimizing third-party software components and modern communication stacks
  • Work in a modern, agile development environment based on model-driven methods, which gives you the opportunity to help shape holistic solutions that go beyond individual embedded platforms
  • Take on responsibility as part of a dedicated, agile team and actively contribute to the development of high-performance, reliable, and high-quality software products
  • Benefit from collaborating in interdisciplinary and international teams, exchange ideas with experts from a wide range of disciplines, and help shape innovative technologies in a global environment
  • Personal and professional development: Grow in a technologically leading environment, build connections, and help drive innovation across a wide variety of industries


Your profile

  • A successfully completed degree in computer science, electrical engineering, communications and information technology, or a comparable field
  • Several years of professional experience in hardware-oriented embedded software development using C/C++ under real-time operating systems (RTOS), as well as in-depth knowledge of Python and Git-based development environments
  • In-depth knowledge of Ethernet-based communication protocols such as TCP/IP, TLS, and PTP; ideally supplemented by experience with industry standards such as IEEE 1588, TSN, and X.509
  • Knowledge of C#, SQL, GoogleTest, and Jenkins, as well as experience with Azure DevOps/Pipelines, Visual Studio Code, or modern CI/CD processes, is a plus
  • Strong conceptual and analytical skills, as well as the ability to communicate complex technical issues to various stakeholders in a way that is tailored to their needs, understandable, and practical
  • Business-level proficiency in German and very good English skills




What are your benefits?

  • Structured onboarding: A clear onboarding plan, joint starting days with other new employees, and dedicated contact persons will support you from day one
  • Flexible working: Permanent employment contracts, flexible working hours, the option to work from home, part-time arrangements, and sabbatical opportunities
  • Global network: Collaboration with experts across our international locations
  • A unique working atmosphere and an appreciative corporate culture: Monthly office events, a first-name culture, short communication channels, and working towards shared goals
  • A steep learning curve: Varied responsibilities in an innovative environment, with diverse projects across different industries and clients
  • Personal and professional development: Individual mentoring and coaching, ACADEMY training courses, and an open feedback culture
  • Attractive career opportunities: Transparent career paths, the opportunity to take on responsibility quickly, and international career prospects
  • Performance-based compensation package: Fixed and variable salary components as well as assessments every six months




Good to know

Employment type: Permanent employment
Work model: Hybrid, combining remote work and office-based work
Workplace: Mannheim or Heidelberg


Your contact person

Sinja Seyfert

description_html:
YOUR TASKS

As a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) in the Tech Advisory area, you will take on a key role in complex transformation projects. You will support our clients in the digital and organizational evolution of their business models and processes - from strategy development through to operational implementation.
You will work at the intersection of business, technology, and change management, applying agile methodologies in a targeted and effective way. In transformation projects, you will play a central role by bringing structure, clarity, and strong execution capabilities.

Your responsibilities will include a wide range of tasks:

  • Supporting transformation initiatives: Assisting clients in the structured development and optimization of organizations, processes, and ways of working
  • Interface management between business and IT: Gathering, structuring, and aligning business requirements while ensuring a shared understanding of project objectives
  • (Partial) project management: Independently planning, coordinating, and delivering projects with a strong focus on sustainable results
  • Applying agile methodologies: Using agile ways of working and taking on relevant roles (e.g. Scrum Master or Product Owner) within projects
  • Change management: Designing and supporting transformation processes, including stakeholder management and implementation support
  • Process analysis and optimization: Identifying improvement opportunities and developing as well as implementing efficient, digitally enabled processes
  • Management-level communication and reporting: Conducting structured analyses and preparing content tailored to decision-makers and steering committees


YOUR PROFIL

We are looking for people with drive, a strong sense of responsibility, and a clear affinity for technology and transformation.
What you should bring to the role:

  • A completed degree in (Business) Informatics, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field of study
  • Several years of professional experience (at least 3–5 years) in management consulting or in transformation/digitalization projects
  • Certification in agile project management, ideally as a Scrum Master or Product Owner, as well as hands-on experience applying agile methodologies
  • Strong technological understanding: Ability to translate modern technologies (Cloud, Data & AI, Cybersecurity) into scalable IT architectures and digital platforms
  • Project management expertise: Experience managing (sub-)projects, including planning, steering, and stakeholder communication
  • Experience in transformation and change management: Ability to support organizational change in a structured way and ensure sustainable implementation
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills combined with a pragmatic, solution-oriented working style
  • Excellent MS Office skills (especially PowerPoint and Excel), along with strong presentation and communication abilities
  • High level of initiative, strong teamwork skills, and a customer-oriented mindset
  • You have very good German and English language skills (minimum C1 level in both languages)


YOUR BENEFITS

  • Supportive Team Culture: Team cohesion is important to us - we support one another and foster a healthy office culture. Our event team organizes regular after-work events to encourage exchange and connection beyond the workplace.
  • Early Ownership & Responsibility: From day one, you will take on exciting tasks with real responsibility – whether on your project or by contributing to internal initiatives. You help shape the way we work.
  • Clear Career Development Paths: You will find an environment that supports, challenges, and advances your professional growth. We offer clearly defined career paths and a transparent competency framework for every level.
  • Creative Work Environment: We give you the freedom and time to develop creative solutions and provide the best, most modern hardware to support you (Apple or Windows).
  • Employee Benefits: Flexible working models, a BahnCard, JobRad, Spendit card, Wellpass, and a company pension scheme contribute to your well-being. In addition, you’ll enjoy the best coffee from our new espresso machine and a fully stocked soft drinks fridge in the office.
  • Attractive Vacation Policy: You benefit from 30 days of paid vacation per year and the flexibility to work from home.

Bloombase baut die führende ERP-Plattform für Cannabis-Apotheken in Deutschland.   • Du sorgst dafür, dass Audit-Sicherheit, lückenlose Protokollierung und DSGVO-Konformität sauber im Code verankert sind – bei uns Kernanforderung, kein Nachgedanke

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Stack: Frontend mit React, Backend mit Node.js (NestJS) und durchgängig JavaScript/TypeScript

title: Full-Stack Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Renewa
description_html:
Deine Rolle

Wir bauen Renewa One – das zentrale System, mit dem wir die Sanierung von Gebäuden managen. Wir entwickeln radikal anders als die meisten: KI-first mit Claude Code. Der Code entsteht schnell und in großer Menge – die eigentliche Kunst liegt nicht mehr im Tippen, sondern im Beurteilen, Zusammenführen und Verantworten.


Deine Mission

  • Du entwickelst neue Features unseres Sanierungs-Management-Systems – KI-assistiert und auf Basis unserer bestehenden Architektur.
  • Du bringst Pull Requests verlässlich zum Release: reviewen, testen, Konflikte lösen und dafür geradestehen, dass nur sauberer, korrekter Code live geht.
  • Du bist die entscheidende Qualitätsinstanz für KI-generierten Code – du erkennst die subtilen Fehler, die eine grüne Pipeline nicht sichtbar macht.
  • Du hältst die Codebase konsistent und wartbar: gemeinsame Muster und ein sauberes Datenmodell statt Wildwuchs.
  • Du verantwortest den Weg von der Idee bis zum Release mit – damit Features schnell und in guter Qualität bei den Nutzern ankommen.


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung mit Claude Code: Du entwickelst KI-first mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren KI-Coding-Agents) und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihn blind zu übernehmen. Bei uns ist das die Grundlage der Arbeit, kein Bonus.
  • Full-Stack-TypeScript mit echter Tiefe: Du bist im Frontend (React) sattelfest und kannst Backend-Code – APIs, Datenbank-Queries, Services – selbst schreiben und korrigieren. Nur so kannst du ihn wirklich beurteilen statt nur durchwinken. 
  • Urteilsvermögen fürs Merge-Gate: Du liest Pull Requests kritisch, gibst klares, konstruktives Feedback und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, was released wird. 
  • PostgreSQL & Datenmodellierung: Du verstehst Transaktionen, Indizes, Fremdschlüssel und Migrationen – und behandelst das Schema als langlebigen Contract, nicht als Wegwerfartikel.
  • Sauberes Git-Handwerk: Rebase, Merge-Konflikte, CI-Pipelines und ein Branch-basierter Workflow sind für dich Alltag.
  • Disziplin statt Ego: Du arbeitest mit den bestehenden Mustern des Teams, statt bei jedem PR deine eigene Meinung durchzudrücken.
  • Du wohnst bereits in Hamburg: Diese Stelle ist nicht remote zu besetzen. Du solltest bereits in Hamburg oder im Umland wohnen und bereit sein, mehrmals in der Woche aus unserem Büro in Winterhude zu arbeiten.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C-Level: Um intern gut mit unseren Mitarbeitenden zu kommunizieren und ein Verständnis für ihre Wünsche und die fachlichen Ansprüche zu entwickeln, sind sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse notwendig. 
Schöne Extras:
  • Erfahrung mit Fly.io / Docker und der Anbindung externer APIs (z. B. CRM- oder Buchhaltungssysteme)
  • Blick für UI-Konsistenz und Design-Systeme
  • Interesse an der Bau- / Sanierungs-Domäne

title: Working Student (f/m/d) Business Development & Operations
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at UnternehmerTUM gGmbH
description_html:
Über uns

TUM Venture Labs is a joint venture initiative of UnternehmerTUM an TUM. We combine a network of domain specific incubators acting as springboard for Entrepreneurship in deep tech and life sciences. Our mission is to help start-ups with strategic advice, infrastructure, and an active network of academic and industry experts to scale from first idea to investor readiness.

Are you ready to make an impact? Help us in our business development efforts to build Europe’s biggest domain specific incubator network. We are looking for enthusiastic team member throughout this journey – and need you for it! We are happy to welcome a:

Working Student in Business Development & Operations (f/m/d) for the TUM Venture Labs in Munich/ Garching

We are looking for a Working Student (Business Development & Operations, 15-20h/week) to support ourbusiness development team at TUM Venture Labs. This role is ideal for students eager to gain hands-on experience in operations, stakeholder management, fundraising, and sponsorship processes. You will gain insights on all the mentioned topics within the individual labs and discover the best practices in sponsorship of each individual domain and industry.

As part of our team, you will help streamline internal processes, refine data management, and support engagement with partners and sponsors. You will support and enhance the information flow at the interfaces TUM and UnternehmerTUM, and the TUM Venture Labs (and the interfaces between the different labs).


Deine Aufgaben

  • Assist in the refinement and management of our contact management system (our active sponsors and prospects) for partner & sponsor relations
  • Support the team in managing the Interfaces to different labs (and cross-lab activities) and interface to UTUM TUM
  • Develop and implement strategies tailored to different labs and domains to strengthen sponsorship engagement, support existing sponsors, and attract potential new sponsors through targeted initiatives and domain-specific opportunities
  • Analysing communications, information, and experiences of different stakeholders to derive best practices in sponsorship management
  • Support fundraising and sponsorship processes, including research, data tracking & outreach
  • Help set up structured workflows for sponsor management, especially using advanced AI tools
  • Support in preparing reports, presentations, and funding applications
  • Assist in day-to-day operations and business development activities
  • Work closely with our business development team


Dein Profil


  • Enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program (Business, Management, Finance, or related fields)
  • Strong interest in deep-tech innovation and diving deep in the relevant industries and deep-tech domains
  • Structured and detail-oriented, with a proactive problem-solving approach
  • Experience with Salesforce, Notion, and AI tools is a plus
  • Strong communication skills in English (German is a plus)
  • Strong analytics skills and ability to simplify complex set of information and derive strategies and best practices. Able to obtain relevant information needed to support us in our mission.
  • Experience with stakeholder management.


Deine Vorteile

  • A hands-on role in one of Europe’s leading deep-tech startup ecosystems
  • Opportunity to work closely with business leaders
  • Flexible working hours to fit your studies
  • Hybrid work setup: Work from TUM Venture Labs (Munich) + remote flexibility
  • A dynamic environment with opportunities to expand your startup knowledge & network


Vielfalt ist uns wichtig

Diversity makes our team stronger. We warmly encourage all qualified people to apply, regardless of gender, social or ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.


Kontakt

Nadine Heuberger, People & Culture Manager
UnternehmerTUM GmbH
Lichtenbergstraße 6, 85748 Garching/München

title: UVC Partners: Data & AI - Master Thesis / Internship (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at UnternehmerTUM gGmbH
description_html:
About us

UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies.
Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha.

At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way.


Your mission

You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions.


Your profile

  • You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university.
  • You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro).
  • You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop.
  • You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it.
  • You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required.

How we work
We are an AI-powered development team. Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write.
Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you.

Potential Research Directions
These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads.
1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot.
2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data.
3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several.

Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own.


What we offer

  • Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors.
  • Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events.
  • Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship.
  • Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions.
  • Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on.
  • AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly.
  • Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively.

Interested?
Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you!


Diversity is important to us

Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.


Contact

Unternehmertum Venture Capital Partners GmbH , c/o Munich Urban Colab, Freddie- Mercury-Straße 5, 80797 Munich, Germany

www.uvcpartners.com

UVC Partners is an equal opportunity employer.

UVC Partners is an independent venture capital fund. For efficiency, we use certain shared services from UnternehmerTUM. This is why parts of the application process may appear UTUM-branded, and your application will be processed by UVC Partners and UnternehmerTUM.

description_html:
JOIN OUR TEAM

As a Working Student Category Management you will be supporting the Category Management team in handling the Westwing shop portfolio through new product selection and maintenance of the existing offering to secure business and meet sales targets. This position is permanent and based in Munich.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Support product selection from new and existing premium and contemporary brands
  • Analyse category performance on a weekly and monthly basis
  • Conduct competitor research in target categories
  • Support assortment strategies within defined categories
  • Collaborate closely with experienced Category Managers and learn how to build a best-in-class assortment in Home & Living categories


YOU COME WITH

  • Enrolled on a Business Administration, Management, or equivalent degree programme
  • Passion for Home & Living as well as a strong sense for products, trends, and aesthetics
  • Strong analytical and communication skills combined with a structured working style, high motivation, and a keen curiosity for continuous learning
  • Solid MS Office skills, especially in Excel and PowerPoint
  • Excellent written and spoken language skills in English


WHY WESTWING

If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.

At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here is what you can look forward to:

  • A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration
  • An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone
  • A flexible hybrid setup with ideally 3 office days per week - because strong connections and quick collaboration make great ideas happen
  • Work-from-anywhere opportunities for up to 4 weeks per year - as fresh perspectives spark bold ideas
  • 30 days of paid holiday to rest, recharge, and come back ready to create
  • A beautiful, centrally located, dog-friendly office with inspiring spaces, a sunny terrace, and good food - designed for moments that energise and connect
  • Exclusive discounts - 40% off Westwing Collection, 20% off third-party brands (each on non-reduced items), 10% Family & Friends discount, plus special-occasion vouchers
  • Wellbeing support through mental health resources, sports memberships, and preventive care
  • Sustainable mobility options with discounted public transport and JobRad - moving with purpose and care for the planet
  • Support for working parents, including our on-site Westwing Wichtel daycare and a partnership with multilingual provider Elly & Stoffl
  • One annual Social Impact Day to give back to a cause you care about - because being human is our true superpower
  • Team rituals that celebrate results and togetherness - from Summer & Winter Parties to Oktoberfest


ABOUT US

Westwing, Europe’s #1 in Beautiful Living e-commerce, is present in 20+ European countries and achieved a GMV (Gross Merchandise Volume) of EUR 507 million in 2025. As Europe’s premium one-stop destination for Design Lovers, it offers a unique brand experience with a carefully curated assortment of the Westwing Collection and 3rd party design brands. The integrated platform combines Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, the B2B Service (Westwing Business) and the Westwing Design Service. Westwing’s team works together on its shared purpose to “Excite people to create homes that unlock the full beauty of life”. Founded in 2011, Westwing is headquartered in Munich and went public on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in October 2018.

Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. We’re made up of passionate people who are creative enough to disrupt the status quo, brave enough to fail and smart enough to win. So come, be part of the “wow, you work at Westwing?” crowd.

Diversity is deeply rooted in our culture. Our mission doesn’t stop to inspire only your design choices, it continues to embrace an inclusive lifestyle filled with respect to everyone’s uniqueness, cultural differences and equal opportunity.

Sales & Category Management

JOIN OUR TEAM

Als Senior Tax Manager unterstützt du unser Finance-Team bei der Betreuung aller steuerlichen Themen der Westwing Group. Du verantwortest dabei die Erstellung des Konzernsteuer-Reportings nach HGB und IFRS, betreust die Ertragsteuererklärungen der deutschen Konzerngesellschaften und treibst spannende Tax-Operations- sowie Digitalisierungsprojekte aktiv voran. Diese Position ist unbefristet, der Arbeitsort ist München.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Eigenständige Berechnung der laufenden und latenten Steuern für den Konzernabschluss nach HGB und IFRS (IAS 12) einschließlich ETR-Überleitung sowie Erstellung aller relevanten Anhangsangaben (Tax Notes) im Rahmen des Fast-Close-Prozesses
  • Fachliche Erstellung der laufenden Ertragsteuererklärungen der deutschen Konzerngesellschaften
  • Fachliche Kommunikation mit Finanzbehörden sowie aktive Betreuung steuerlicher Betriebsprüfungen
  • Mitarbeit und Übernahme von Aufgaben bei Steuerprojekten, z.B. Einarbeitung in Spezialthemen des Ertragsteuerrechts, Mitwirkung beim Tax CMS sowie Optimierung von Schnittstellen in Steuer-Workflows
  • Enger Austausch mit internen Fachbereichen des Konzerns (Accounting, Controlling, Legal, FinTech) sowie Koordination externer steuerlicher Berater im In- und Ausland


YOU COME WITH

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, der Rechtswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Steuerrecht oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation (ein abgelegtes Steuerberaterexamen ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung)
  • Mindestens fünf Jahre praktische Berufserfahrung innerhalb einer Konzernsteuerabteilung oder eine vergleichbare Tätigkeit in einer Big Four- oder mittelständischen Steuerberatungsgesellschaft
  • Fundierte und praxiserprobte Kenntnisse im deutschen Ertragsteuerrecht (Organschaften, Verlustnutzung) sowie in der steuerlichen Rechnungslegung nach HGB und IFRS (insb. IAS 12)
  • Freude an steuerlicher Projektarbeit, Affinität zu digitalen Steuerprozessen und die Bereitschaft, dich tief in neue Ertragsteuerthemen einzuarbeiten
  • Lösungsorientierte, strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise im dynamischen Umfeld mit dem Anspruch, Themen eigenständig voranzutreiben
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie versierter Umgang mit gängigen ERP-Systemen (z.B. Microsoft BC, LucaNet) und Tax-Reporting-Werkzeugen

  • Deep expertise in AL programming, Visual Studio Code, and Business Central development frameworks

  • Strong knowledge of modern integration techniques, including APIs, Web Services, and Power Platform
  • Practical experience leveraging AI-powered tools and services to enhance ERP functionality
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on optimising Business Central performance
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams, paired with fluency in English

Founded in 2011, Westwing is headquartered in Munich and went public on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in October 2018.

Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. We’re made up of passionate people who are creative enough to disrupt the status quo, brave enough to fail and smart enough to win. So come, be part of the “wow, you work at Westwing?” crowd.

Diversity is deeply rooted in our culture. Our mission doesn’t stop to inspire only your design choices, it continues to embrace an inclusive lifestyle filled with respect to everyone’s uniqueness, cultural differences and equal opportunity.

description_html:

As a Working Student in Purchasing, you'll help keep our SAP master data clean, accurate, and reliable — supporting the planning and procurement decisions that depend on it every day.

description_html:
Your way into the future

Shape the Future of Global Connectivity
At Mynaric, we're building the optical fiber for the skies.
As a pioneer in laser communications, we develop cutting-edge technology that enables ultra-fast, secure, and reliable data transmission between satellites, aircraft, drones, and terrestrial platforms. Our solutions are helping shape the future of aerospace, defense, and global communications networks.
We are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Senior Sales & Business Development Manager, Asia-Pacific to accelerate our growth across one of the world's most dynamic aerospace and defense markets.
This is more than a sales role.
You will be the driving force behind expanding Mynaric's presence across Asia-Pacific, developing strategic customer relationships, identifying major business opportunities, and transforming qualified prospects into long-term partnerships. You will engage directly with senior executives, government stakeholders, defense organizations, system integrators, and innovative commercial space companies that are shaping the future of connectivity.
Just as importantly, you will remain actively involved after contract award, working closely with our Customer Project Manager and Project Leads to ensure customer expectations, program execution, and business objectives remain aligned throughout the customer journey.
If you are energized by complex sales cycles, strategic customer engagement, international business growth, and working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and mission-critical programs, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a lasting impact.


What awaits you at Mynaric

Drive Growth Across Asia-Pacific
You will be responsible for identifying, developing, and securing new business opportunities across government, defense, aerospace, satellite, and commercial markets throughout the region.
By building a deep understanding of customer priorities, market trends, and competitive landscapes, you will position Mynaric's solutions to solve critical challenges and create long-term value for our customers.

Build Trusted Customer Relationships
You will develop strong relationships with key decision-makers, program leaders, procurement organizations, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
Acting as a trusted advisor, you will help customers understand how Mynaric's technology can support their strategic and operational objectives while creating opportunities for sustainable business growth.

Partner with Customers Throughout the Entire Lifecycle
Unlike traditional sales roles, your involvement does not end at contract signature.
You will work closely with the Customer Project Manager and Project Leads to support successful program execution, facilitate customer communications, participate in program reviews, and ensure alignment between contractual commitments, delivery milestones, and customer expectations.
Your ability to maintain trust during execution will be critical in driving customer satisfaction, repeat business, and long-term partnerships.

Lead Complex Sales and Capture Activities
You will own opportunities from initial market engagement through qualification, proposal development, negotiation, contract award, and expansion.
Working alongside Sales Engineering, Engineering, Product Management, Program Management, and Executive Leadership, you will develop winning strategies that differentiate Mynaric and maximize customer value.

Influence the Future of Our Business
As the voice of the customer within Mynaric, you will bring market insights, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback back into the organization to shape product development, strategic decision-making, and future growth initiatives.

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in sales, business development, strategic account management, or capture management within the aerospace, defense, satellite, communications, or high-technology sectors.

  • Proven success leading multi-stakeholder sales campaigns from opportunity identification through contract award.
  • Strong commercial acumen and track record of delivering measurable business growth.

  • Ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels, from engineers and program managers to C-level executives and government decision-makers.
  • Experience working successfully in a matrix organization with cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with project delivery teams while maintaining a strong customer focus.
  • Natural relationship builder who thrives on creating trust, alignment, and long-term partnerships.
Personal Attributes
  • Strategic thinker with a growth mindset and strong commercial instincts.
  • Customer-centric and passionate about solving complex challenges.
  • Confident communicator and presenter with excellent negotiation skills.
  • Self-motivated, resilient, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving international environment.
  • Collaborative team player who enjoys working across functions and cultures.
Education & Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Aerospace, Telecommunications, Business, or a related discipline.
  • MBA or equivalent advanced business qualification is an advantage.
  • Experience with CRM and pipeline management tools.
  • Fluent English is essential; additional Asia-Pacific languages are highly desirable.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 50% of working time.


What we offer you

Be part of the company that is changing the world!
Have you always wanted to come to work in your favorite space outfit? Then you are exactly right with us! Forget bureaucracy and work together with inspiring colleagues from all over the world while you embark on an incredible journey with Mynaric to work on unique and challenging projects and make a real contribution to the future of connectivity.

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder.
